method: The same note was played and captured several times, and every take after the first was aligned to it by cross correlation to a fraction of a sample, scaled by its best fitting level, and subtracted. What is left is reported next to the noise floor of the silence before the note, raised 3 dB because two takes carry that noise independently. A residual at the floor is the strongest claim this chain supports: not that the unit repeats exactly, but that it repeats to everything the chain can see.
